ofxImport.pageTitle: Import an OFX or QFX file
ofxImport.pageDescription: Import bank and credit card transactions from an OFX or QFX file.

fileUpload.stepTitle: Upload your OFX or QFX file
fileUpload.description: Select a statement file that you downloaded from your bank or credit card provider.

errors.invalidFormatNamed: "{name}" is not an OFX or QFX file.

errors.uploadUnavailable: The uploaded file is no longer available. Upload your OFX or QFX file again.

accounts.currentBalancePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the sum of imported transactions
accounts.skippedNote: {count} account(s) will be skipped. Its transactions will not be imported. | {count} accounts will be skipped. Their transactions will not be imported.

quickActions.createNewForUnmatched: Buat baru untuk yang tidak cocok

tooltips.mapExactMatches: Link each account to an existing account that has the same name and currency.
tooltips.createNewForUnmatched: Set each account that is not linked to an existing account to create a new account.
tooltips.reset: Hapus semua pilihan dan cocokkan lagi.

review.warningsHint: The import can continue, but some transactions need special handling.

warnings.dateUserFallback: {count} transaction used the file's fallback time zone | {count} transactions used the file's fallback time zone
warnings.fitidMissing: {count} transaction had no bank transaction ID | {count} transactions had no bank transaction ID
warnings.fitidDuplicate: {count} duplicate bank transaction ID was found in the file | {count} duplicate bank transaction IDs were found in the file

review.duplicatesHint: These transactions look like transactions that you already have. Check a row to import it anyway; unchecked duplicates are skipped.

execute.partialImportNote: Some transactions might already be imported.

done.successDescription: Your OFX or QFX transactions are now in your account.
done.partialTitle: Imported with {count} issue | Imported with {count} issues
done.partialDescription: Most transactions were imported. The list below shows what was not imported.
done.emptyTitle: Tidak ada yang baru untuk diimpor
done.emptyDescription: Each transaction was skipped or was already in your ledger.
done.failedDescription: No transactions could be created. Review the errors below.
done.balanceWarningBody: The final balance could not be set on each account. Review these accounts and adjust their balances if necessary.
done.errorsTitle: {count} transaction could not be imported | {count} transactions could not be imported

errors.rowImportFailed: This row could not be imported.
errors.accountBalanceDesync: An account balance could not be updated after the import.
errors.rowsSuppressed: {count} more row failed to import from this row onward. Only the first {listed} errors are listed. | {count} more rows failed to import from this row onward. Only the first {listed} errors are listed.

leaseExpired.title: File yang Anda unggah tidak lagi tersedia
leaseExpired.description: The parsed copy of your OFX or QFX file was released after a period of inactivity. Your mapping choices could not be kept. Start the import again.
